name: Spectacular
description: +1 point for every shot on target from outside the penalty area and +5 points for every goal scored from outside the penalty area. One player per club, six players, unlimited budget.
_scoring_note: On top of the normal goal points, not instead of them. Same for every position, because the source names no difference. base_scoring holds both keys at 0. Modelled from attempts from outside the box - see OBOX_PRIOR_MATCHES in fpl_solve.py.
source: https://fplchallenge.premierleague.com/ home page, read 2026-11-06: "Gameweek 10 Challenge - Spectacular - Your players earn +1 point for every shot on target from outside the penalty area and +5 points for every goal scored from outside the penalty area. One player per club. Unlimited budget." The API confirms the club limit: event 10 overrides.rules.squad_team_limit = 1, released = true, overrides.scoring empty.
